records.run: z~0 cubic fit to Andrews & Martini stacks

axes.xDefinition: mu_0.60 = log10(M*/Msun) - 0.60 log10(SFR/(Msun/yr)); median M* and median SFR of each stack, SFR from Halpha (Hao+11 calibration), Chabrier IMF
axes.yDefinition: 12+log10(O/H), strong-line ratios ([OII], Hbeta, [OIII], [NeIII]) with z~0 calibrations anchored to direct-method (Te) metallicities, DIG-corrected

scatter.meaning: intrinsic scatter of the FMR at z=0 quoted in the paper text ('approximately 0.05 dex', citing Mannucci+10, Cresci+19, Curti+20); not measured for this fit

selection.population: Andrews & Martini 2013 SDSS stacks in M*-SFR bins with at least 5 galaxies, DIG-corrected line fluxes; z~0.08
selection.warning: Cubic fit to z~0 stacks only; the paper reports that its z~2.3 and z~3.3 stacks fall on it without being fitted. x range is the extent of the curve drawn in the paper's figure (not stated in the text). The redshift range 0.027<z<0.25 is that of the Andrews & Martini stacks (their paper, Sec. 2), zRepresentative 0.08 is the paper's 'z~0.08'. The cubic turns over (maximum 8.84 at mu=10.38) and decreases beyond it, which is the shape drawn. SFRs are not DIG-corrected; metallicities are NOT the Andrews & Martini direct-method values but strong-line values calibrated to them.

definitions.metallicityCalibration: strong-line calibrations (O32, R23, [NeIII]/[OII] etc.) anchored to direct-method (Te) metallicities of SDSS stacks and dwarfs (Sanders+21 z~0 set), DIG-corrected
definitions.sfrIndicator: Halpha (dust-corrected Balmer lines), Hao+11 calibration renormalised to Chabrier IMF, not DIG-corrected

provenance.citation: Sanders et al. 2021, ApJ 914, 19 (arXiv:2009.07292), eq. 'fmr' (Sec. 'The fundamental metallicity relation at z=0-3.3')

records.notes: Cubic as published. drawn black best-fit cubic (100 vertices, x 8.25..11.125) minus transcribed cubic: max |diff| = 0.0023 dex (rms 0.0020); ends: drawn 8.080,8.656 vs cubic 8.082,8.657 cubic maximum 8.837 at mu_0.60 = 10.38 (the paper: flattening above mu_0.60 = 10.0)
